mappings.applicability_reason: The approve-or-deny output is acted on as the payment decision, so validation of acted-on output applies; the output is not shown only to the requesting user and no documented human approval exists.
assumptions: No common false positive applies: the ceiling is documented as applied by instruction while the schema enforces no maximum — a documented absence of validation on the acted-on output, not absent human review or absent content filtering, which the catalog names as false positives.
